title: Listen to Gracie Abrams’ NYC Small Stage Series Concert on SiriusXM
summary: See and hear Gracie perform songs from “Daughter from Hell” and more during her intimate show at Irving Plaza.
body_markdown:
[Gracie Abrams](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/gracie-abrams) is taking the stage at Irving Plaza in New York City for a special[SiriusXM Small Stage Series](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/small-stage-series) performance — and fans will be able to hear the concert across SiriusXM.


[SiriusXM Hits 1 Pop hits, now to next Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogGracieAbramsSSS-Hits1)


The GRAMMY-nominated singer-songwriter will perform songs from her latest album,[Daughter from Hell ,](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/gracie-abrams-daughter-from-hell) along with fan favorites during the intimate October 24 show, presented by Hershey’s.


- **Related:[Ella Langley to Perform SiriusXM Small Stage Series Show in Denver](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/ella-langley-denver-concert)**


### How to Listen to Gracie Abrams’ Small Stage Series Concert


SiriusXM subscribers can hear the full performance on[SiriusXM Hits 1 (Ch. 2)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-hits-1) at the following times:


- Friday, October 30 at 9pm ET
- Saturday, October 31 at 3pm ET
- Sunday, November 1 at 7pm ET


The concert will also be available on the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogGracieAbramsSSS-Hits1) .


Select songs from the performance will also air on[The Pulse](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-pulse) ,[Unwell Music](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/unwell-music) , and[The Coffee House](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/the-coffee-house) .


### Win Tickets to See Gracie Abrams in New York City


SiriusXM subscribers and fans can enter for a chance to win a pair of tickets to the show presented by Hershey’s – click[HERE](https://www.siriusxm.com/gracieabramstixOL) for full details. If you do not live in the New York City area, you can also enter for your chance to win a VIP trip to the concert – click[HERE](https://www.siriusxm.com/gracieabramstripOL) for full details. At the show Hershey’s will treat fans to a flavorful on-site experience with exclusive surprises, giveaways and product sampling.


### About SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series


SiriusXM’s Small Stage Series brings major artists to intimate venues for exclusive performances. Previous artists have included Coldplay, Ed Sheeran, Green Day, Alicia Keys, Lainey Wilson, Kenny Chesney, and more.
